label: copy-phase input u (fed-back u), mid-recall in longer sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input token is u (97% of activation mass). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, on the first occurrence of a token, or at recall_idx 0-1. Activation is strongest at recall_idx 3-4 (t 11-13) and in longer sequences (L 8-9); top examples are u inputs at recall_idx 2-3 with L=9, and a second u right after one also fires. Small leakage on copy-phase v, q, w and e. Precision is low: only about 1/4 to 1/3 of eligible copy-phase u steps fire, and no token-history variable we checked (next_out, prev tokens) separates the ones that fire from the ones that do not. The predicate restricting to recall_idx 2-5 and L>=6 has F1 0.50 and mass recall 0.89 on dev; the plain predicate copy-phase u has recall 0.94 and mass recall 0.97 but precision 0.21.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: u, v, q, w, e, c; least: k, 2, i, m) and the token being output (most: q, u, c, v, e, w; least: h, i, -, r); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, t=12.
